interpretation.plateau: Recent training-round Score blocks decline after the R70s while SD-LoRA continues to update, so the run is active but recent gains are not stable.
interpretation.training_signal_hypothesis: Selection is tightly coupled to tasks that already achieve clean exact success, which can starve persistently hard tasks of supervised updates.
interpretation.direction_hypothesis: Recent adjacent SD-LoRA update directions are weakly aligned on average and frequently oppose one another, consistent with unstable incremental learning.
interpretation.carrier_context: Most online state change is carried by SD-LoRA; the other carriers update much less frequently. This is context for successor design, not a bug claim.

decision_boundary: Do not change the running R160 DirectApply treatment. Use these diagnostics to design a separate successor under the same 128-rollout budget; evaluate any new treatment independently.
scientific_boundary: These are training-process diagnostics and hypothesis-generating correlations. They do not establish a causal explanation for the plateau, a frozen final score, or a GDR-vs-DirectApply winner.
